text: Core courses Statistics, Operations Research, System Engineering, Management, Basic Engineering of Industries, Quality Control and Dependability, Human Factors Engineering, Facilities Planning and Logistics Analysis, Production Planning and Control, Technological Economics, and Management Information System. Objective This objective is to train students to synthetically use the scientific methods and technology of modern management to design, evaluate and improve the flow of enterprises’ personnel flow, logistics and information. After graduation, students will be comprehensive, interdisciplinary middle-and-high-ranking managerial and technical personnel. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Management or Engineering is granted.
